received_works.body:
Hello, your art is very cool! If possible, I would like to request a drawing of my demon / fallen angel man "Lequiste." 

Could I get a picture of him with crazy eyes and/or a ヤンデレ expression. Blood is okay as well. Otherwise, please draw what you wish.

Character background: He is a thousand year old demon. He worked in the military for a long time and uses a spear as his weapon. His wings are like sparrows. He is generally a relaxed person but can be crazy in certain situations. He can be very violent without remorse.

His reference: https://imgur.com/a/cxvXCCE
His clothing: https://imgur.com/a/Fmr3Q7A

Hope this is alright, please choose whatever clothing you wish or something new. Thank you.

その友人のオリジナルキャラクター（OC）も描いていただけませんか？
ポーズや表情は自由で結構です。

OC：https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KEF9Z-mwSDntQWonZocvkHMHJNuFrR1d?usp=sharing

OC：https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VHXcKraP1-Yieb-ZSm5EKhkb1uWvQ6xS?usp=sharing

依頼内容と料金が合わない場合は、調整していただけると幸いです。
お読みいただきありがとうございます。

こんにちは、ヤミです。ぜひ私のイラストを描いてください！
YouTubeやTwitchでの使用、およびグッズの制作・販売に使用する可能性があるため、レイヤーを分けてください。頭、耳、肩が切り取られないようにしていただけると助かります。
メインの衣装で描いてください。 
ヤミは謎めいた色気があり、危険だけど魅力的。ドミナントなママキャラです（へへ）。耳と尻尾から煙が立ち上り、人を惹きつける存在。興奮しすぎるとヤンデレな一面も。葬儀屋を経営しており、設定には死に関する要素が多く、鎌を使って戦います。 刺激的なイラストはOKですが、全裸は避けてください。

ヤミが狂乱状態にある姿を描いてほしいです！彼女の目とクモユリに焦点を当ててください。サイコで、暗く、恐ろしい雰囲気にしてください。設定上、ヤミは友人を殺された復讐のために鎌で人々を殺しています。 復讐の最中の姿を描いてください！

私のオリジナルキャラクター：https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1Bq9QMitGga4-y8RDcFRbfjhPGKU_u8Hm

とにかく、あなたが得意とするような狂った感じの、錯乱した雰囲気を表現してほしいです！すごく良さそう！

1 character. 17 year old male who looks feminine. So, otokonoko to put it in familiar terms. The context is that this character was castrated at a young age and didn't go through male puberty. Think of like gwyndolin from dark souls as a reference for how the body would look. Feminine face too, with long silver-grey hair parted at a 7:3 ratio. He has a big scar going across his eyes from a blade wound when he was a child. His eyes are still there but he is blind, so there should be a dullness to them. He wears a feather coat meant for travelling, and beneath it a robe like something a shepherd would wear with a rope that ties the waist.

He should be turned away from the camera but looking back over his shoulder at the camera. Background doesn't have to be anything complicated, but earthy tones are better than anything else. His face should be a slight frown but something fitting confusion and caution not sadness.

This is my OC called Julia btw. You are free to take creative liberty
